data.name: Expandica
data.detailed_description:
Build your settlement, manage resources, and conquer enemy camps—all while pursuing your ultimate goal: closing the portal that unleashes evil creatures into this world.

As you develop your settlement, you’re free to shape it however you like. With a variety of decorative elements and the ability to modify the terrain by placing or removing blocks, creativity plays a key role in how your world evolves.

You can control villagers and assign them to different tasks—working, patrolling, exploring, or fighting enemies. This flexibility allows you to play at your own pace and approach challenges in your own way.

Conquering enemy camps requires strategic thinking. Each camp is designed as a unique puzzle, meaning that simply having a large army won’t always guarantee victory.

As developers, we aimed to blend settlement building and resource management with RTS mechanics to create a balanced and engaging experience. We hope you enjoy the game!

data.short_description: A voxel-based RTS where you need to develop your own settlement, manage resources, explore the world, conquer camps of enemies and, finally, close the portal from which the dark cultists and demons are coming. The world of Expandica awaits!
